root_cause: copier_live_demo_preflight.py passed the follower endpoint resolver's keyword-only second parameter positionally: resolve_account_snapshot_base(account, *, global_base_url) was called as resolve_account_snapshot_base(facct, <url>). Python raised TypeError('resolve_account_snapshot_base() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given') for EVERY follower, and the gate's try/except converted it to a spurious ENDPOINT_RESOLVE_ERROR (fail-closed, so never unsafe, but it masked the true per-tenant endpoint state and blocked truthful readiness reporting before the Sponsor-present #46->#48 demo).
fix: One-line, behaviour-preserving: pass global_base_url by name -> resolve_account_snapshot_base(facct, global_base_url=getattr(_s, 'GUVFX_WINDOWS_AGENT_BASE_URL', '') or ''). The gate predicate (e_ok = st.ok AND st.per_tenant), the fail-closed try/except, and the verdict logic are UNCHANGED. No migration, no flag, no authorization, no host/broker contact. Host gates (HOST_PROBE_REQUIRED) still force NOT_READY from a backend-only probe, so the fix cannot yield a false READY.
